subtopics.title: Wireless Links and Network Characteristics
subtopics.summary: How wireless links differ from wired links: signal attenuation and path loss, interference from other sources, multipath propagation, SNR and bit error rates, plus an introduction to CDMA as a shared-medium access protocol used in wireless networks.

subtopics.title: WiFi: 802.11 Wireless LANs
subtopics.summary: The IEEE 802.11 (WiFi) standard: 802.11 architecture (BSS, access points, channels, SSIDs), the 802.11 MAC protocol (CSMA/CA), the 802.11 frame format, mobility within the same IP subnet, advanced features, and Bluetooth personal area networks.

subtopics.title: Cellular Networks: 4G and 5G
subtopics.summary: Cellular Internet access architecture: 4G LTE network elements and architecture, LTE protocol stacks and radio access network, network attachment and power management, the global cellular network as a network of networks, and emerging 5G cellular technology.

subtopics.title: Mobility Management: Principles
subtopics.summary: The network-layer challenges of mobility: forms of device mobility, locating and routing to a mobile user, home networks versus roaming on visited networks, direct versus indirect routing, and handover as a user moves between points of attachment.

subtopics.title: Impact of Wireless and Mobility on Higher Layers
subtopics.summary: How wireless links and mobility affect transport- and application-layer protocols: TCP challenges over lossy wireless links, and treating bandwidth as a scarce commodity when serving content over cellular connections.
